name: Pika Audio
summary: Score a video, generate a song from lyrics, make sound effects from a sentence, or clone a voice at 48kHz. Four audio models, up to 20x cheaper than comparable ones, through the $10/month API Club.

name: /design in Claude Code
summary: Type /design and get editable UI artboards that match your codebase's existing style — pick one, tweak it, then have Claude implement it. Research preview in the CLI and desktop app on Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise.

name: GPT-5.6 Luna on ChatGPT Free
summary: Free and Go accounts now get unlimited text chats on the current-generation model, with the old five-hour caps gone. Limits on images, files, and tools stay as they were. Rolling out in ChatGPT.

name: Qwen3.8-27B
summary: Run a 27B multimodal model on a 16GB GPU or Mac — text, images, and video, 262K context, nothing leaving your machine. Apache 2.0 weights on Hugging Face, with quantized builds down to 9GB.

name: Gemini 3.7 Flash
summary: Build coding agents on a cheaper workhorse model — $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 output, half the old Flash price through December 31. Generally available now in the Gemini API as gemini-3.7-flash.

name: Harness v0.1
summary: Run an open-source terminal coding agent under the MIT license, with models, tools, sandboxes, and UI all swappable plugins. Points at DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Developer preview, so expect breaking changes.

name: Grok 4.6
summary: Point agents at a frontier-grade model for $2 per million input tokens and $6 output, with a 500K context window. Currently the cheapest model at the top of the intelligence rankings. Live in the API now.

name: Muse Glimmer
summary: Run a 30B agentic model on your own machine for tool calling, coding, and image input. Quantizes under 20GB, so an M4 Mac or an RTX card handles it. Apache 2.0 weights on Hugging Face, plus Ollama and LM Studio.
